MycoTrack explains every permission before it asks for it. The permission centre shows the current state of each one and links to the system settings when a permission has been permanently denied.

MycoTrack records mushroom foraging trips entirely on the device. No account, no subscription and no commercial map service is required: the maps come from OpenStreetMap and from the Institut Cartogràfic i Geològic de Catalunya (ICGC).

The offline maps of Catalonia that ship with the application are published by the ICGC under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence. The street map is © OpenStreetMap contributors, also under the Creative Commons Attribution licence.
MycoTrack is free, open source and has no ads. If you enjoy it and want to support its development, you can invite the author a coffee.

Games – While we wait for the mushrooms to appear
Little pixel games to play in the forest while the mushrooms grow. Each one keeps its own ranking.
Bounce the ball with the basket and knock down the mushrooms.
Drag the basket, tap to launch, double tap to shoot.
Stack the mushroom bricks and clear rows.
Tap left / right to slide, tap the middle to rotate, swipe down to drop, swipe sideways to wall.
Eat the spores and escape the puffball ghosts.
Swipe to steer. Golden spores let you eat the ghosts!
Tap the falling mushrooms in time with the music.
Tap a lane when its mushroom reaches the golden line. Don\'t let it escape!
Find the matching mushroom pairs before the clock runs out.
Tap two cards to flip them. Match every pair to grow the forest.
Whack the puffball moles popping out of the holes.
Whack ghost mushrooms and golden puffs. Never touch the blue slugs!
The classic Klondike with four suits of mushrooms.
Tap a card to pick it up, tap a pile to drop it. Double-tap sends a card to its foundation. Tapping a foundation auto-sends the best card.
New forest games will appear in future versions.
